svg.text: Login → active basket → save script with temporary credentials → run locally
1 Sign in · OpenID Connect authorization-code flow
Set temporary OIDC state cookie; redirect to IAM
Redirect to callback with code + state
Callback: code + state + temporary OIDC state cookie
Validate state / ID token; store session (RT encrypted)
Set HttpOnly SID cookie; /auth/me returns profile + XSRF cookie
Browser holds SID, not UAT. Auth resolves SID in Redis; a still-valid UAT near expiry may be refreshed using RT.
Expired UAT requires login again. Client secrets stay on the server.
Read / update basket + SID (mutations: XSRF cookie + header)
Bearer UAT; forward XSRF pair for mutations
Via Auth: owned basket observations → select active basket
FastAPI validates UAT and basket ownership; basket mutations validate XSRF. React resolves and deduplicates file references.
POST /auth/download/download-script: file refs + SID + XSRF pair
Session lookup → Bearer UAT + file references
For each file: token exchange + download-client credentials
Via Auth: script source + expiry / errors (Cache-Control: no-store)
Download Service maps LFNs, checks HTTPS hosts and builds the manifest. Browser saves a script named with a UTC timestamp.
Script contains URLs + SATs; no SID, UAT, RT or client secret. Per-file exchanges do not guarantee file-limited scopes.
XSRF is sent, but Auth Service and download routes have no explicit CSRF validation.
4 Run locally · Python 3.9+ · intermediate DL3 data in dCache
Run the timestamped script with Python 3.9+
For each file: HTTPS GET + Bearer SAT
File bytes OR redirect to HTTPS pool URL
If redirected: follow URL; strip bearer when host / port changes
Save archive-named files + report (script name, UTC run time, results)
Local execution contacts storage only: no app session, IAM call, token refresh or browser CORS requirement.
Keep script private; regenerate when credentials expire. Browser logout alone does not revoke exported SATs.
SID = session cookie ID • UAT = user access token • SAT = storage access token • RT = refresh token
